captions: A smiling woman in a white t-shirt and dark green apron stands at a shop doorway, her face partially visible as she hands a bouquet of yellow ranunculus to a cyclist, with a shop window featuring narrow wooden mullions and dappled rain on the pavement in the background.
A bouquet of yellow ranunculus wrapped in brown paper is held against a backdrop of a shop window with narrow wooden mullions, viewed through a glass pane that reflects a blurred building facade.
A smiling woman's profile, her dark hair pulled back, is seen against a background of a tall, narrow window with vertical wooden mullions and a light-colored stone wall.
A person in a dark green apron holds a bouquet of flowers, with a background of a shop window displaying more blooms and a wet pavement.
Two hands, one in a green apron and one in a cream jacket, meet to pass a bouquet of yellow ranunculus wrapped in brown paper, with a shop window and potted flowers visible in the background.
A cream-colored button-up jacket worn over a white t-shirt, with a hand gripping a bicycle handlebar, against a softly lit background of wooden window mullions and a wet pavement.

A person in a green apron and blue jeans stands on a concrete step, wearing white sneakers; a wooden bench edge is visible to the left, and wet pavement stretches below. The toe of the most prominent shoe points toward the right of the image.
A close-up of a blue bicycle's front wheel and fork, with a dark, wet pavement and a concrete step in the background.
A close-up of a blue bicycle's pedal and crankset, with a person's black pants and white sneakers visible, set against a wet, dark pavement.
